name: THE US GRANT
insider_take: This storied grande dame has been San Diego's most prestigious address since 1910, where old Hollywood glamour meets modern luxury in the heart of the Gaslamp Quarter.
whats_special: Named after President Ulysses S. Grant and built by his son, this National Historic Landmark has hosted everyone from Charles Lindbergh to modern presidents. The hotel's original crystal chandeliers and mahogany millwork create an atmosphere of timeless elegance, while its prime location puts you steps from Petco Park and the vibrant Gaslamp nightlife.
pro_tip: Book a corner suite on floors 8-11 for stunning views of both the harbor and Balboa Park, and don't miss the hotel's famous Sunday brunch in the elegant Grant Grill.
dont_miss: The Grant Grill's "ladies only" lunch tradition (now open to all but still celebrating its pioneering history), the original 1910 Otis elevator still in operation, and the hotel's secret speakeasy-style bar that pays homage to San Diego's prohibition era.
pros: Historic luxury hotel with elegant architecture and timeless sophistication
Prime downtown San Diego location in the Gaslamp Quarter
Exceptional service standards as part of Marriott STARS Program
Upscale dining and rooftop bar with city views
cons: Historic building may have smaller room sizes typical of classic hotels
Premium downtown location reflects in higher pricing
